🏃‍♂️不久

这是为 SillyTavern 或 vn/rpg 游戏生成表情包的工作流程。这是基于此的示例图像

💻我的规格

  • 🔥GPU - RTX 3060 12GB

  • 📦RAM - 32 GB RAM DDR5 6000

  • 🧠CPU - 锐龙 7500F

🌐模型链接

主要型号Qwen-Image-2509-gguf：https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF/tree/main

剪辑：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

VAE：https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors

照明 4 步洛拉：https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning/blob/main/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors

我的主要模型是Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-Q3_K_S.gguf，如果您想获得更好的结果，请随意使用更大的模型。

📖使用方法

1) 拖放图像

2) 选择设置

  1. 有或没有背景

  2. 一个表达式或多个表达式（默认 28 个）

3) 给角色起个名字

4) 按“运行” 按钮

结果将位于输出文件夹中

📝如何更改/扩展表达式列表？

左栏- 图像名称列表

右栏- 左栏图像的正面提示。

[ 负提示是静态的 ]

您可以更改、添加、删除提示和图像名称，只需对两列执行此操作即可。左列和右列必须具有相同数量的字符串。

📦如何安装Bria-RMBG-2.0

  1. 前往模型页在拥抱的脸上。

  2. 接受许可，您必须获得授权才能执行此操作。

  3. 下载所有模型文件链接。您可以手动下载每个文件，或“git克隆”它，更多关于它这里

  4. 将模型文件放入ComfyUI\models\rembg\RMBG-2.0文件夹

  5. 完成

🫧删除背景

选择“启用保存的结果 BG 删除”

如果您需要从已创建的图像中删除背景，请使用这个工作流程。

🎥动画表情

您可以使用这个为您的表达式创建无缝循环工作流程.

示例：https://ibb.co/qMyqJmzw

将动画保存为 webp 格式。

深受启发这个工作流程

🏃‍♂️Shortly

This is workflow generates expression packs for SillyTavern or your vn/rpg game. Here is example based on thisimage

💻My specs

  • 🔥GPU - RTX 3060 12GB

  • 📦RAM - 32 GB RAM DDR5 6000

  • 🧠CPU - Ryzen 7500F

🌐Model links

Main model Qwen-Image-2509-gguf:https://huggingface.co/QuantStack/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-GGUF/tree/main

Clip:https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/text_encoders/qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors

VAE:https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/Qwen-Image_ComfyUI/blob/main/split_files/vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors

Lighting 4-step lora:https://huggingface.co/lightx2v/Qwen-Image-Lightning/blob/main/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509/Qwen-Image-Edit-2509-Lightning-4steps-V1.0-bf16.safetensors

My main model isQwen-Image-Edit-2509-Q3_K_S.gguf, feel free to use larger models if you want to get a better results.

📖How to use

1) Drag&Drop image

2) Choose a setting

  1. With or without background

  2. One expression or multiple expressions (28 by default)

3) Give character a name

4) Press "Run" button

Result will be in output folder

📝How to change/expand list of expressions?

Left column- list of image names

Right column- positive prompts for left column images.

[ Negative prompt is static ]

You can change change, add, delete prompts and image names, just do that for both columns. Left and right column must have the same amount of strings.

📦How to install Bria-RMBG-2.0

  1. Go tomodel_pageon huggingface.

  2. Accept licence, you must be autorized in order to do that.

  3. Download all model fileslink. You can download every file manually, or "git clone" it, more about ithere

  4. Put model files inComfyUI\models\rembg\RMBG-2.0folder

  5. Done

🫧Remove background

Choose "Enable Saved result BG Removed"

If you need to remove the background from already created images, usethisworkflow.

🎥Animated expresion

You can create seamless loop for your expression, with thisworkflow.

Example:https://ibb.co/qMyqJmzw

Save animation in webp format.
